title: LDPC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/LDPC_Decoder.md
text: Decode quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check code, 3 inputs, 5 outputs; {Parity-check matrix} sets the qC-LDPC matrix 0 35 1 26 0 10 16 16 34 4 2 23 0 51 -1 49 20 -1 -1 -1; 12 28 22 46 3 16 51 2 25 29 19 18 52 -1 37 -1 34 39 -1 -1; {Block size} sets the size of block, {Algorithm} sets the type of algorithm, {Scaling factor}, {Decoding termination criteria} sets the termination criteria, {Source for number of iterations} sets the source selection for number of iterations, {Number of iterations}, {Maximum number of iterations} and {Enable parity check output port} sets the parity check status. Values come from the instance.
